title: Tidebone Crossing
description: Three closed limestone vaults, each formed by two tapered limbs meeting at the crown, stand on fractured stone footings.

review.notes: Round 3 (final). Fixed: the ribs now cross in overlapping pairs at the apex, the doorway and path are gone, and the terrazzo speckle is gone (hero, turn tiles, closeup_base). Still failing: every rib is still one smooth, evenly tapering tube like an elephant tusk, with no change of section, no fractures and no weathering, so the group reads as polished ivory rather than ancient limestone (closeup_upper); the footings are loose angular shards stood around each rib foot rather than a buttress the rib grows out of, and the turf is a flat blotchy disc with a hard edge (closeup_base); at 80 m the scale figure is still only a dot in the hero. Fix: vary the rib section along its length with flattened faces and broken arrises, add fractures and localized grime, rain streaks and lichen, merge the shards into a single splayed buttress the rib flows into, bank the turf irregularly into the terrain, and frame the hero so the figure reads.
